# Eric Li

> Designer and builder based in Brooklyn. Co-founder of Versive and creator of Scratch.

Eric Li is a designer and builder based in Brooklyn, NY, interested in the intersection of design and code. He is the co-founder of Versive, an AI-first user research platform, and the creator of Scratch. He previously worked at Uber, Bread (acquired by Alliance Data), and Vareto, and was once an investment banker. He studied economics at the University of Chicago.

## Projects

- Versive (https://getversive.com): An AI-first user research platform that helps teams conduct and synthesize user research at scale.
- Scratch (https://ericli.io/scratch): An offline-first, open source markdown note-taking app for Mac, Windows, and Linux. No cloud, no account, no subscriptions.
- Juno (https://juno.ericli.io): A naval roguelike you play in the browser.
- Whisker (https://github.com/getversive/whisker): An AI-powered usability testing CLI tool.

## Writing

Eric writes about product design, software development, AI tools, and building products. His articles are available at https://ericli.io/writing.
